card.name: Linking words in lists of patient groups
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas inside lists of vulnerable patient groups, such as elderly, very young, debilitated or pregnant, right before the next group is named.

modes.label: Age groups joined by and/or
modes.description: The word 'and', 'or', 'very' or a comma sits between age groups like elderly, adolescent, young or old.

modes.label: Lists of risk conditions
modes.description: A comma or 'or' separates conditions such as ill, debilitated, pregnant or nursing before the next one.
